policy: Reviewed expansion cluster for emerging China AI-infrastructure, GPU, accelerator and high-performance-computing employers. Each enabled entry must point to an employer-owned public recruiting surface or a public ATS used by that employer. Third-party job boards may be used only as discovery/evidence and are never crawled here when they require login, CAPTCHA or security verification.
